api_access.notes: Personal API keys on every plan; GraphQL covers every object. Complexity-based rate limit is generous for read-only pagination.

schema_introspection.notes: Full GraphQL introspection with types and enums. Relationships are implicit in the graph rather than declared as association metadata.

relational_integrity.notes: Every relation is a stable-id edge enumerable in bulk through connections; issueRelations exposes links as first-class records.

export_throughput.notes: Cursor pagination at up to 250 nodes per page; a 100k-issue workspace exports in well under 6 h.

attachment_portability.notes: Uploads on uploads.linear.app download with the API key; most attachments are links to external systems. Descriptions and comments are Markdown.
